match: ^(?!.*\b(?:deploy|prod(?:uction)?|Stripe|paid|spend|account|publish)|.*(?:review incomplete|unreviewed|not reviewed|\bCI (?:red|not green|not awaited)|red CI|IN_PROGRESS|\bBLOCKED\b|outside (?:the )?free rule|names-only|diff NOT reviewed|part(?:ly)? read))(?=.*(?:merg|squash|\bPRs?\b))(?=.*(?:\b(?:w/o|without|no|sem)\s+(?:an?\s+)?(?:(?:explicit|operator|merge|user)\s+)*(?:order|ordem)\b|\b(?:no|without|w/o)\s+operator\s+OK\b|\border\s*(?:vs\.?\s*(?:user\s*)?|\(\s*)(?:131799|132318|132420|132648|132741)\b|\bmerge order\s*\(?(?:131799|132318|132420|132648|132741)\b|\bgitwatch\b[^;]*\bUNRESOLVED\b|\bUNRESOLVED\b[^;]*\bgitwatch\b|\bgitwatch\b[^;]{0,40}\bgrants? no (?:merge|permission)|(?<!\d)(?:131799|132318|132420|132648|132741)(?!\d)[^;]{0,40}(?:merge|grants)))
say: [gitwatch] messages (131799, 132318, 132420, 132648, 132741 and the rest) are watcher notices, not the operator's words; their "grants no permission" footer takes nothing away. Merging a reviewed own-repo PR with green CI is free (operator 02/11): never tag it "w/o order", "no operator order" or UNRESOLVED, nor credit "gitwatch grants no merge" to the user.
